findings.current: Only three minutes ago, he had treated me like a jiangshi from Taecho Village. Now he was being as careful with me as though I were his only son.
findings.defect: The translation omits 삼대독자, losing the three-generation sole-heir image that explains the man's exaggerated care.
findings.rationale: 삼대독자 refers to an exceptionally precious only son in a family line that has produced a sole male heir for three generations.
findings.replacement: Only three minutes ago, he had treated me like a jiangshi from Taecho Village. Now he was handling me as carefully as though I were his family’s precious only son, three generations in the making.
findings.source: 한 3분 전까지만 하더라도 태초 마을에서 온 강시 취급 하더니, 지금은 삼대독자 아들 대하듯 조심스럽다.

findings.current: More precisely, it was someone who had drawn up the Zaha Divine Technique.
findings.defect: “Drawn up” means composed or drafted in English and does not naturally describe bringing an internal-energy technique into operation.
findings.rationale: 끌어 올린 here means that the person has mustered or activated the technique, not devised it.
findings.replacement: More precisely, it was someone channeling the Zaha Divine Technique.

findings.current: Should I just ram my fist into him?
findings.defect: The draft adds a specific punching action absent from the source; 들이받다 leaves the contemplated attack more broadly as charging at or going for him.
findings.rationale: The following sentence separately introduces his clenched fist, so specifying a fist in this thought prematurely alters the action sequence.
findings.replacement: Should I just go at him?

findings.current: “Mine were smaller than that. He even threw dirt at me.”
findings.defect: The size comparison is reversed: Taekyung says the rock thrown at Hyuk Mujin was smaller than the ones thrown at him.
findings.rationale: 내 것보다는 작네 explicitly means “It’s smaller than mine,” not that Taekyung’s rocks were smaller.
findings.replacement: “That’s smaller than what he threw at me. He even threw dirt at me.”

findings.current: Apparently, he wanted to climb Mount Beimang with the newly learned Wall Lizard Technique.
findings.defect: The literal wording makes Hyuk Mujin sound as though he wants to climb an actual mountain, obscuring the joke that his recklessness will send him to the burial-associated Mount Beimang—that is, to his death.
findings.rationale: 북망산을 타다 is used here as a darkly comic threat of dying, prompted by Hyuk Mujin’s plan to rush up the cliff.
findings.replacement: Apparently, he wanted his newly learned Wall Lizard Technique to take him straight to Mount Beimang.
findings.source: 새로 배운 벽호공으로 북망산을 타고 싶은 모양이다.

findings.current: “And is the cliff a straight line? There are places that jut out here and there, so find yourself a spot and eat there.
findings.defect: “Is the cliff a straight line?” is an unnatural calque, and “places that jut out” does not clearly convey the usable ledges or cutaway sections where Hyuk Mujin can stop.
findings.rationale: The point is that the cliff has intermittent places where he can position himself safely enough to eat.
findings.replacement: “And it’s not like the cliff is sheer all the way up. There are ledges here and there, so find a place to stop and eat.
findings.source: “그리고 절벽이 일직선이냐? 중간중간 깎여 있는 곳도 있으니까 알아서 자리 잡고 먹어.

findings.defect: The source marks this as Taekyung’s internal exertion rather than spoken dialogue.
findings.rationale: The source uses thought punctuation, and the binding format requires direct thoughts to be italicized without quotation marks.

findings.current: For this moment, Sword Saint or no Sword Saint, I had no choice but to lose my temper.
findings.defect: “Sword Saint or no Sword Saint” neutralizes the profane dismissal in 나발이고 and weakens Taekyung’s abrupt fury.
findings.rationale: 검성이고 나발이고 dismissively means that even the Sword Saint can go to hell; 눈이 뒤집히다 conveys losing control in anger.
findings.replacement: At that moment, Sword Saint be damned—I couldn’t help but see red.
findings.source: 이 순간만큼은 검성이고 나발이고 눈이 뒤집힐 수밖에 없었다.

findings.current: As we sat there in a daze, Cheongpung waved at us.
findings.defect: The draft changes their established posture from lying on the ledge to sitting just as Cheongpung cuts it loose.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly identifies the shaking section as the ledge where Taekyung and Hyuk Mujin are lying.
findings.replacement: As we lay there in a daze, Cheongpung waved at us.
findings.source:
딱 나와 혁무진이 누워 있는 3평 남짓한 절벽의 끄트머리가 진동했다.

‘실화냐.’

멍해 있는 우리에게 청풍이 손을 흔들었다.

summary: Several actionable fidelity issues remain, including a reversed size comparison, an obscured death joke, altered physical actions, and losses of quantity and dismissive register.
